title: Hyperplane reduction of a non-equidimensional completion
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a catenary Noetherian local domain, let $B=\widehat A$ be its maximal-ideal completion, and suppose a minimal prime $\mathfrak q$ of $B$ has $1<d=\dim(B/\mathfrak q)<\dim A$, where $d$ is the least dimension of a minimal-prime quotient of $B$. There exist a nonzero $f\in\mathfrak m$, a prime $\mathfrak p$ of $A$ minimal over $fA$, and a minimal prime $\mathfrak r$ of the maximal-ideal completion $\widehat{A/\mathfrak p}$ such that $\dim(A/\mathfrak p)=\dim A-1$ and $\dim(\widehat{A/\mathfrak p}/\mathfrak r)=d-1$. In particular $0<d-1<\dim(A/\mathfrak p)$. [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]
